name: Nashiki Ria
source:
A 2nd year student and the most popular girl at Honoue Academy. 
Ria always shows suggestive attitude toward men, but when they decide to confess to her, she always reject them immediately.
She really loves to tease the protagonist, and when Eimi's not looking, she goes even farther to seduce him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1184906&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
